annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1234 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2226 as regards the medical devices for which the instructions for use may be provided in electronic form
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1234 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2226 as regards the medical devices for which the instructions for use may be provided in electronic form
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Regulation amending 2021/2226 to extend electronic instructions for use to all medical devices intended for professional users, including Annex XVI devices without a medical purpose. It keeps paper instructions for lay users and requires UDI database links to the electronic instructions. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends electronic instructions for use to all medical devices intended for professional users under MDR 2017/745
Includes Annex XVI devices without an intended medical purpose
Paper instructions required where devices may foreseeably be used by lay persons
Manufacturers must provide the e-IFU internet address to the Eudamed UDI database once registration is mandatory
